articles.title: Got Yeast? How a Kitchen Ingredient Could Fight Plastic Pollution
articles.summary: Did you know baker's yeast can grab tiny plastic bits from water? In this experiment, you'll test how much yeast it takes to clean up microplastics. It's a real science project you can try at home!

articles.title: Lighter Than Cotton Candy: Meet the Fluffiest Planets Ever Found!
articles.summary: Two new planets are so light they'd float in a giant bathtub! TOI-791 b and c are bigger than Jupiter but weigh almost nothing. Citizen scientists helped spot them 1,110 light-years away.

articles.title: Tiny Soil Heroes: How Bacteria Could Save Crops from Salty Soil
articles.summary: Salty soil is a growing problem for farmers, but tiny bacteria called pseudomonads can help plants grow stronger. Scientists found these microbes make roots tougher without reducing salt inside the plant.
